Pushed a small follow-up for the red typecheck: the two runtime regression tests passed `null` to `ObjectMatrix<ICellData>`, whose `setValue` accepts `ICellData`, so `runtime.service.spec.ts` failed with TS2345 at lines 203 and 218. They now clear the cells with `realDeleteValue`, which keeps the tests for results arriving after a formula was removed without widening any production types.

`pnpm --filter @univerjs/engine-formula typecheck` reproduced both errors before the change and passes after it; `runtime.service.spec.ts` passes (32 tests).

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
